author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I never understand why people need OpenClaw or Hermes agent until I have my AI subscriptions.

When I use AI at work, I have virtually unlimited tokens, the tokens are always there, I don't have any rush.

When I had Github Copilot before, the premium request won't disappear, I can take my take time to use Copilot at my own pace, as long as I finished using up my 1000 premium request before the end of month, I am good.

Now I have an AI subscription, the tokens count reset every 5 hours, use it or lose it.  I feel the obligation that I HAVE to burn all the tokens.  Since you can't sit in front of your laptop every 5 hours, so you setup a Claw to keep burning your tokens.
